uk.name: planning.data.gov.uk (Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government), datasets planning-application and brownfield-land
uk.covers: England, only councils that publish to the platform
uk.rule: Every record whose location intersects a 200 m circle around the pin.

nyc.name: NYC Department of Buildings, DOB NOW: Build job application filings (NYC Open Data, dataset w9ak-ipjd)
nyc.licence: NYC Open Data terms of use (public data, no key)
nyc.covers: New York City, DOB NOW filings
nyc.rule: Within about 200 m of the pin: new-building filings, and other filings with an estimated cost of USD 1 million or more. Newest 15.

miami.name: City of Miami, Building Permits Since 2014 (City of Miami open data, ArcGIS)
miami.licence: Public records published as open data by the City of Miami
miami.covers: City of Miami only (not other municipalities in Miami-Dade County)
miami.rule: Within 200 m of the pin, permits with a total cost of USD 1 million or more. Newest 15.

not_covered: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have their own planning portals without a national open API. For other markets we know of no free official planning API without a key; we link the official register where we have one.
privacy: Names, phone numbers and e-mail addresses of applicants, owners, agents and contractors are never copied.
